units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 8">Gen. R. s. 8</cite> <he>אדריינטיס אני עושה אותה</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. <cite ref="A01373"><he>אינדרטין</he></cite>; corr. acc.) I shall make it into (use the vacant ground for the erection of) a banqueting hall. [The context forbids the identification of our w. with <cite ref="A02131"><he>אַנְדְּרִיאַנְטוֹס</he></cite>.]
